post_observation_amendments.timing: After worker observations and method review, before final facts and main adoption. Not source-blind preregistration; initial strict worker holds retained in raw reports.
post_observation_amendments.lifespan_endpoint_exception: A death/lifespan-end-only discrepancy may be retained while admitting a birthplace when original full native name and exact native DOB, multiple distinctive career anchors, additional institutional identity context, unique native key/no competing identity and no death-dependent eligibility/selection effect all pass. No birthdate/name/identity exception; no native facts repaired. General gates in method_qa.json.
post_observation_amendments.signed_expert_newspaper: Original edited obituary by named professional colleague may receive conservative S2; disclose genre and shared authorship, never host-only S1 or inferred peer review.
post_observation_amendments.conventional_biographical_header: Original section and neighboring layout can establish the explicit structured birth-side place without literal born wording. Disclose convention/absence of legend; S3 does not waive relationship gate.

Kassanis_rule: Literal Macedonian born retained as raw wording; separate annotated Macedonia interpretation only; no modern country or hemisphere inference.
Crisp_rule: Original BIOGRAPHIES section/neighboring paired birth-date-place and death-date-place layout inspected; direct interpretation explicitly recorded, London only/unknown.
Adam_rule: No acquired semantic person/place body or edge; hold. Existing Cambridge and all BP evidence/grades unchanged.
active_DOB_conflicts: Argyris and Laver remain active in copied sidecar; death-endpoint exception does not apply.
protocol_deviations: Group A logged two adaptive query intents after requests, honestly retained. All original-source planned opens had prior intent; no failed-route retry.
frozen: Native DOB/calendar/identity/cohort/eligibility/country/QIDs/coordinates/DOB tiers/old evidence/official-field status/hashes/prior facts and untargeted complete objects.
